changes: Correct dp-1 baseline at all three placements; add dp-6 and dp-7 at Lemmas 3 and 5. No original article text or live Site modification.

changes.title: Theorem 5: use quadratic weights
changes.original: The modular construction gives an edge of step a its Euclidean length sqrt(1+a²).
changes.changed: Use positive quadratic weights k*x²+1+a², where k=ℓ−1, in the verified construction.
changes.why: An actual n = 30, ℓ = 3, x = 10 counterexample has a shorter competing path with the printed weights. Quadratic weights restore uniqueness and the required graph sizes. The k*x² baseline makes extra backward-layer steps too expensive and is essential.

changes.title: Ruzsa–Szemerédi extremal direction
changes.original: The prose defines RS by saying every sufficiently sparse graph is partitionable into n induced matchings.
changes.changed: Use the extremal maximum edge count among graphs that are partitionable into at most n induced matchings.
changes.why: The printed implication is reversed relative to the argument. The formalization defines the actual maximum and proves its subquadratic bound.

changes.title: Subset lower bound requires at least two terminals
changes.original: Theorem 3 states its terminal range asymptotically without a two-terminal lower endpoint.
changes.changed: The exact finite lower bound requires 2 ≤ T ≤ N.
changes.why: One terminal has only zero self-distance, preserved by an edgeless graph. This is a necessary explicit boundary condition.

changes.title: Corrected near-threshold consequence
changes.original: Theorem 4’s “in particular” consequence claims the square-root-logarithmic deficit range.
changes.changed: The verified replacement uses T ≤ N^(2/3) exp(−32(log N)^(3/4)), with the stated finite threshold and quantifier order.
changes.why: The printed stronger existential remains unresolved. The obstruction concerns deriving it from the displayed rate, not a counterexample to the existential theorem.

changes.title: Distinct indexed paths need positive length
changes.original: The layered construction permits a layer-count parameter without explicitly excluding the one-layer boundary.
changes.changed: Require positive k = ℓ−1 when constructing distinct inner indexed paths.
changes.why: At k = 0 the indexed routes collapse to zero-edge walks. This is an explicit domain clarification in the checked construction, not a new impossibility claim for arbitrary lower-bound graphs.

changes.title: Lemma 3: sufficient alternative counting bound
changes.original: Lemma 3 bounds the total branching triples by binomial(p,3).
changes.changed: Prove uniqueness of the branching vertex for three fixed paths, then inject excess edges into ordered path triples to obtain E ≤ 2n+p³.
changes.why: This proves the same asymptotic Theorem 1. The sharper literal binomial count is not separately claimed as formalized.

changes.title: Lemma 5: demand endpoints may be internal
changes.original: The lazy-tree lemma says its leaves are exactly the demand endpoints; its proof describes an iterative process.
changes.changed: Prove every nonroot leaf is a demand endpoint, allowing demand endpoints to be internal, using finite minimization.
changes.why: On root–a–b with demands to both a and b, a cannot be a leaf. Leaf inclusion suffices for Theorem 2. The checked existence proof makes no O(n²) iteration or runtime claim.
